data.heading: If you can't see which dollar made the phone ring, you're guessing.
data.lede: We wire every call, form and booking back to the campaign, keyword and page that produced it. Then we send the sold-or-lost verdict back to Google and Meta, so the bidding learns what a customer looks like instead of what a form fill looks like.

items.title: Every call counted, and heard
items.body: Tracked numbers per channel, recorded calls, and a conversion that fires on a real conversation, not a wrong number.

items.title: A submission is a lead, a page view isn't
items.body: Forms, quote tools and booking flows tracked end to end, spam filtered, and the lead delivered to your phone the moment it lands.

items.title: Sold or lost, back to the platforms
items.body: Mark a lead sold in your CRM or in our app. That verdict goes to Google and Meta as an offline conversion, and the ads get smarter.

items.heading: The plumbing most agencies skip.
items.body: None of this is glamorous. All of it is the difference between a report that says "47 conversions" and a report that says "11 customers, $42 each, from these three keywords."
